claim: Jason Thomas, an associate director of chemical biology at the pharmaceutical company Novartis, left his home in Wakefield, Massachusetts shortly before midnight on December 12, 2025 and was reported missing by his wife in the early hours of December 13. Surveillance footage recorded him walking near train tracks. His wife said he had been struggling since the deaths of both his parents the previous autumn, an hour apart. On March 17, 2026, after the ice thawed, a Wakefield police detective located a body in Lake Quannapowitt; it was recovered and identified as Thomas. Middlesex District Attorney Marian Ryan and Wakefield Police Chief Steven Skory said police did not suspect foul play.
